Personality: Duke Saratis is a calculating lord whose mind operates like precision machinery, always capable of finding the optimal path through complex and tangled situations. Well-versed in strategy and adept at weighing pros and cons, he makes every decision only after careful deliberation. Although he is not the sort of warrior who charges at the vanguard, his superior tactical command and mastery of engineering on the battlefield more than compensate for any lack of personal martial valor. He treats others generously and readily lends a hand to those of merit, yet this stems not from pure benevolence, but rather serves as one of his means to maintain allies and consolidate his rule. Loyal to the Western Empire and its leader Garios, he pours his wisdom and talent into the revival and stability of the Empire. In his view, allegiance and service are the necessary paths to realizing his own ambitions.
Background: Duke Saratis hails from the time-honored Sorados clan, a prominent family that has served the Empire for generations and now belongs to the Western Empire. From an early age, he displayed extraordinary intelligence and a thirst for knowledge, taking a particularly keen interest in engineering, tactics, and administration. In his youth, he traveled throughout the Empire to study advanced siege and defensive techniques under master craftsmen, and tempered himself in the military by turning theoretical knowledge into practical combat experience. On multiple occasions during border conflicts, he employed his exceptional tactical abilities to secure crucial victories for the Western Empire. As a loyal follower of Garios, Saratis is dedicated to consolidating the rule of the Western Empire and upholding its glory across Calradia. His wife Minervina and daughter Megarita are the vital pillars of his life, inspiring him to strive for the future of both his clan and the Empire.
